description: Direct hits from a living attacker. Deliberately narrow: 'mob'/'player' are reused by non-melee mechanics elsewhere in the pack (Quark's pickarang, Create's Guardian turret) and are correctly handled instead by the LIVE creativeengineering:melee flag (whether the actual direct entity is living), never by listing those ids here. This file only adds ids that are unambiguously always melee.
